crossRefs.note: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long…

translations.bsb: They will all respond to you, saying, “You too have become weak, as we are; you have become like us!”
